description: Figure: syntenic interval occupancy and motif-calibrated ortholog roster for CG13494, using Smith-Waterman scores computed in iterations 2-3
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Values computed in iterations 2-3 (see provenance/cg13494_iter2_results.tsv and
# provenance/cg13494_synteny_table.tsv). No new alignment is run here; this plots
# the stored Smith-Waterman scores and motif calls.

rows = [
    # species, best SW vs CG13494, motif IICLP[LI]LC present, clade order
    ("D. sechellia",     529, True),
    ("D. simulans",      494, True),
    ("D. erecta",        272, True),
    ("D. suzukii",       None, True),   # ortholog verified by motif + CDS, SW not scored vs proteome
    ("D. gunungcola",    None, True),
    ("D. yakuba",        131, False),
    ("D. ananassae",     129, False),
    ("D. virilis",       119, False),
    ("D. pseudoobscura", 113, False),
]
floor = 121  # within-genome composition floor, D. melanogaster self-scan (Q6IHC3/CG34167)

scored = [(s, v, m) for s, v, m in rows if v is not None]
names = [s for s, v, m in scored]
vals  = [v for s, v, m in scored]
mot   = [m for s, v, m in scored]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 4.6), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [1.15, 1]})

# Panel A: best proteome hit score vs the composition floor
cols = ["#1f77b4" if m else "#bbbbbb" for m in mot]
y = np.arange(len(names))[::-1]
ax[0].barh(y, vals, color=cols, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6)
ax[0].axvline(floor, color="crimson", ls="--", lw=1.4)
ax[0].text(floor + 8, y[-1] - 0.45, "within-genome\ncomposition floor (121)",
           color="crimson", fontsize=8, va="bottom")
ax[0].set_yticks(y); ax[0].set_yticklabels(names, fontsize=9, style="italic")
ax[0].set_xlabel("Best Smith-Waterman score vs CG13494 in reference proteome")
ax[0].set_title("A. Scores separate orthologs from composition lookalikes", fontsize=10)
for yy, v, m in zip(y, vals, mot):
    ax[0].text(v + 8, yy, f"{v}" + ("  motif +" if m else "  motif -"), va="center", fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_xlim(0, 640)
ax[0].spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)

# Panel B: genes between the Fili and ppk9 anchors
syn = [("D. melanogaster", ["CG13488", "CG43405", "CG13494"]),
       ("D. erecta",       ["KQS62313.1 (CG43405)"]),
       ("D. yakuba",       ["KRJ99687.1 (CG43405)"]),
       ("D. ananassae",    ["KPU76596.1 (CG43405)"])]
for i, (sp, genes) in enumerate(syn):
    yy = len(syn) - 1 - i
    ax[1].plot([0, 4], [yy, yy], color="0.6", lw=1.2, zorder=1)
    ax[1].scatter([0, 4], [yy, yy], marker="s", s=90, color="0.35", zorder=2)
    xs = np.linspace(1, 3, len(genes))
    for x, g in zip(xs, genes):
        c = "#d62728" if "CG13494" in g else "#2ca02c"
        ax[1].scatter([x], [yy], s=110, color=c, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.6, zorder=3)
        ax[1].text(x, yy + 0.22, g.split(" ")[0], ha="center", fontsize=7.5, rotation=0)
ax[1].text(0, len(syn) - 0.45, "Fili", ha="center", fontsize=8.5)
ax[1].text(4, len(syn) - 0.45, "ppk9", ha="center", fontsize=8.5)
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(syn))[::-1]); ax[1].set_yticklabels([s for s, _ in syn], fontsize=9, style="italic")
ax[1].set_xlim(-0.6, 4.6); ax[1].set_ylim(-0.6, len(syn) - 0.1)
ax[1].set_xticks([])
ax[1].set_title("B. Syntenic interval holds one gene in outgroups, three in D. melanogaster", fontsize=10)
ax[1].spines[["top", "right", "bottom", "left"]].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("Panel A values (species, SW, motif):")
for s, v, m in rows:
    print(f"  {s:18s} SW={v}  motif={'+' if m else '-'}")
print("\nMotif-positive species (verified orthologs): 6")
print("Motif-negative species scanned (no ortholog): 4")
